summary: Dub production: echo and spring-reverb throws, parts muted in and out, filter sweeps, heavy bass
body: The desk is the instrument: send single snare hits, chord stabs or vocal words to a long dotted-8th echo with high feedback, then pull them back.
Spring-style reverb on the snare; high-pass and low-pass sweeps on the echoes; the bass stays dry and loud.
Works on any genre (dub techno, dubstep's roots). Apply: chain/dub-echo on a part (the snare's track or the keys).

track.about: the part to throw into the echo (keys, drums)
